MPSC Aspirants Protest in Pune, FIR Filed Against Representatives

A protest by Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) aspirants took place in Pune, with participants expressing feelings of betrayal by the state. Following the protest, Pune police filed a First Information Report (FIR) against 15 representatives of the aspirants.
